text: You have a girlfriend, but she doesn't like my content. What to do? This question hurts me a little bit, but let's go. Hi, I was just wondering a question. My girlfriend doesn't really get your content and says you only try to justify the things that have been said. For example, the 62 million men attended our APE Academy and she thought you were justifying the men and also said you got destroyed in arguments many times, but she never told me which. What do you say and what can I say? Okay, so here's the weird part for me. If I understand correctly, she actually watched my videos. She heard my arguments. She probably heard the arguments of the people I was responding to and she still walked away with he's completely wrong. He justifies men who do horrible things and he got destroyed. That tells me possibly one of two things is happening. Either she watched the videos and didn't understand any of my arguments and decided to go with the narrative that fits her views or she understood them, at least partly, but still decided to present them in a twisted way because that fits her narrative. And both cases are bad for you. In the first case, she's just not the sharpest tool in the shed, which means the next time the two of you have a disagreement and misunderstanding, anything where you try to explain your side, she's probably not going to understand you either and would just push whatever she believes in. In a second case, where she only accepts what fits her own narrative, it's just a matter of time before this happens to you. You can be doing everything right, caring for her, showing up for the relationship, putting in the work, and none of it matters. The moment something doesn't fit her view, she will paint it however she wants. So by that logic, for her, you always can be wrong and you always can be the one to blame. So the real question is not what I say. The real question is, do you actually want to be in a relationship like that? I genuinely hope you have more self-love and self-respect than that. Now, I'm not saying everyone has to agree with me. If she had said something like, I see his points, I think they're partly valid, but I think he misses this part. Or his rhetoric could land better if he framed it differently. That would be completely understandable. That is just her opinion and you can absolutely live with that. In fact, it is great because then the two of you can actually talk about real topics and have interesting conversations. But I don't think that this is happening here. Hope this helps. My name is Ilyas Abdurin. Thanks and bye.
